strings.check_backup_comment_disable: Performance may be affected during the backup process. If enabled, backups should be scheduled for off-peak times.
strings.check_backup_comment_enable: Performance may be affected during the backup process. Backups should be scheduled for off-peak times.
strings.check_backup_details:
Enabling automated backup will automatically create archives of all the courses on the server at the time you specified.

During this process, it will consume more server resources and may affect performance.
strings.check_cachejs_comment_disable: If enabled, page loading performance is improved.
strings.check_cachejs_comment_enable: If disabled, page might load slow.
strings.check_cachejs_details: Javascript caching and compression greatly improves page loading performance. It is strongly recommended for production sites.
strings.check_debugmsg_comment_developer: If set to a value other than DEVELOPER, performance may be improved slightly.
strings.check_debugmsg_comment_nodeveloper: If set to DEVELOPER, performance may be affected slightly.
strings.check_debugmsg_details:
There is rarely any advantage in going to Developer level, unless requested by a developer.

Once you have obtained the error message, and copied and pasted it somewhere, it is HIGHLY RECOMMENDED to turn Debug back to NONE. Debug messages can give clues to a hacker as to the setup of your site and may affect performance.
strings.check_enablestats_comment_disable: Performance may be affected by statistics processing. If enabled, statistics settings should be set with caution.
strings.check_enablestats_comment_enable: Performance may be affected by statistics processing. Statistics settings should be set with caution.
strings.check_enablestats_details:
Enabling this will process the logs in cronjob and gather some statistics. Depending on the amount of traffic on your site, this can take awhile.

During this process, it will consume more server resources and may affect performance.
strings.check_themedesignermode_comment_disable: If enabled, images and style sheets will not be cached, resulting in significant performance degradation.
strings.check_themedesignermode_comment_enable: If disabled, images and style sheets are cached, resulting in significant performance improvements.
strings.check_themedesignermode_details:
This is often the cause of slow Moodle sites.

On average it might take at least twice the amount of CPU to run a Moodle site with theme designer mode enabled.
strings.performancereportdesc: This report lists issues which may affect performance of the site {$a}
strings.privacy:metadata: The Performance overview plugin does not store any personal data.
